newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo Dec qtr gold profit rises nine pct.
newsitem.headline: Anglo Dec qtr gold profit rises nine pct.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday its gold mines recorded available profit of 340.8 million rand in the quarter to end-December, up nine percent on the preceding quarter.
The firm said the rise reflected a three percent increase in gold production to 54,014 kilograms and a two percent rise in the average gold revenue per kilogram of gold sold to 55,756 rand.
Operating profit was 19 percent higher at 744 million rand, the firm added.
Anglo gold mines' unit working costs dropped two percent to 42,294 rand per kilogram produced and total working costs edged up one percent to 2,284.5 million rand.
Capital expenditure for the period was 38 percent higher at 274.7 million rand and available profit for the year to December 31 was up 158 percent to 1,269 million rand.
